rules.check: paths use the platform separator functions, not a typed slash
rules.evidence: the line that joins a path with a typed separator

rules.check: file names are not assumed to be case-sensitive or case-insensitive
rules.evidence: the line that compares or builds names by case

rules.check: text read from or written to files does not assume one line ending
rules.evidence: the line that splits or joins on a fixed line ending

rules.check: signals and process groups are used only where the platform supports them
rules.evidence: the line that uses a platform-only signal or call
